BiblicalUsage: Ziba is the servant of Saul's house who told David about Mephibosheth. In 2 Samuel 9:2, there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. The fuller story is told on the Ziba profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ziba matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
